name: Pass without Trace
description: A veil of shadows and silence radiates from you, masking you from detection. For the duration, you can't be tracked except by magical means, and you move without a sound.
effect: Shadows and silence cling to you: +10 Thieving for 2 hours.
notes: Out of combat: +10 Thieving for 2 hours: road encounters rarely notice you first, and you can sneak away or sneak attack.
